subject: Temporary throughput buffer & pricing note
messages:
From: Emily Park <epark@clearbridge.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@clearbridge.health
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary throughput buffer for Sept launch

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — we’re about to enter a controlled pilot the first week of September and the traffic profile looks spiky (short bursts up to ~3x our committed QPS). Our procurement team asked if Redwood can provide a short-lived throughput buffer for the 7–10 day launch window and a simple true-up for any overrun.

Two asks: 1) can we get a temporary rate-limit increase (QPS) for the window, and 2) do you have a pricing path where we prepay a small burst allowance at a reduced rate vs paying standard overrun pricing? We’re open to a capped credit or an LOI that covers the week.

I’ve attached a draft PO card from procurement to speed things up. ETA for final PO is Friday. Can we get something on paper by then?

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Director, Product
ClearBridge Health

Attachment: PO_ClearBridge_Sept_launch.pdf (attached by Emily)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@clearbridge.health>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary throughput buffer for Sept launch

Emily — great to hear from you and congrats on the pilot prep. We can absolutely support a short buffer for launch week with a clear reconciliation model. Two quick options I’d propose so procurement has a choice: 

Option A (Prepaid burst credit):
- You pre-purchase a burst credit block (example: 1M token-equivalent) at a 20% discount to standard overrun rate.
- Credits consumed only during the agreed window. Any unused credit rolls forward (valid 30 days).

Option B (Rate-ceiling waiver + true-up):
- Temporary QPS bump to X (we’ll confirm exact limit after you share expected peak QPS).
- Overrun billed at a reduced margin (10% discount to published overrun rate) and invoiced as a one-line true-up.

I’m looping Jordan for the formal pricing sheet and Ben for approval on the concession bands. If procurement can sign the attached LOI and issue the PO by Friday we’ll route a temporary capacity change and lock in the rate for the window.

Notes: we’ll need a short SOW addendum (1 paragraph) and a DocuSign LOI for both options. I attached a rate sheet draft for transparency.

Next step: Jordan — can you confirm the numeric rates and I’ll send an LOI template?

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: rate_sheet_v2.xlsx (draft)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: temporary throughput buffer for Sept launch

Soojin / Ben — forwarding Emily’s ask and Soojin’s options. Numbers below are rounded for email; I’ll drop a precise line-item workbook in the drive if you want.

Option A (Prepaid credit) — recommended for ClearBridge pilot:
- Block: 1,000,000 token-equivalent burst credits
- Price: $0.12 / 1k tokens (20% off our standard overrun $0.15/1k)
- Minimum commitment: $120 (actually $120,000 — see attached breakdown)
- Unused credits: roll forward 30 days; refund subject to finance approval if not used after 30 days.

Option B (Rate-ceiling waiver + true-up):
- Temporary QPS bump to 3x baseline (subject to infra checks)
- Overrun invoiced at $0.135 / 1k (10% discount)
- Reconciliation: single true-up invoice within 14 days after window.

Approval ask for Ben: 1) confirm discount bands (20% and 10%) and 2) allow customer to prepay via PO for Option A (we’ll accept PO then invoice).

I’ll prepare the exact line items and a short SOW paragraph.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary throughput buffer for Sept launch

Thanks — Jordan. Ben here, approving the proposed concession structure for this pilot with the following guardrails: 

1) Discounts limited to the launch window only (explicit start/end dates required in LOI).
2) Cap prepaid credit refund liability to 50% refund after 30 days unless finance signs off.
3) Any extension beyond 14 days post-window requires a second sign-off from Sales Director.

We can proceed with Option A as the preferred path — it gives ClearBridge predictable economics and lowers legal friction. Soojin, push the LOI template to Emily and request PO + billing details ASAP. Make sure the LOI includes the SOW one-paragraph and the roll-forward clause.

If procurement tries to negotiate deeper discounts, escalate to me. Otherwise, we’re good to lock the numbers.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales (Hosted)
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@clearbridge.health>, contracts@clearbridge.health
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: LOI and PO path for Sept pilot (prepaid burst credit)

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a short LOI (one page) that captures Option A: 1M token prepaid burst credit at $0.12/1k tokens (20% off overrun rate), valid for the window 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-07, unused credits roll forward for 30 days, 50% refund cap after 30 days.

Next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm billing contact and issue the PO (PO number on the attached stub).
2) Sign LOI via DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/EXAMPLE/draft/clearbridge-loi
3) Once PO is received and LOI signed, we’ll open the temporary QPS bump with infra and confirm limits (we’ll coordinate with your SRE).

I’ve attached the LOI and the rate workbook. If you want Option B instead, we can flip, but Option A is already approved on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this buttoned up before Friday.

— Soojin
